title: "Unpublished" style of rendered entities is not accessible (and looks bad)

latest.text: One of the things that's disappointed me with this whole thread is how uninspiring it is. I don't know that this is the right visual, but I think it is better than what we've been considering. There is AI generated patches for Core, Claro &
